items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I don't know if we got Blanche to get him or what.

ctx.x: Right. But they didn't make it, but Cab made an impression. So we found out that he was at this show... I don't know if we got Blanche to get him or what. But anyway, they got ahold of him and talked him into coming again, just to direct it. We were paying him a hundred dollars a week to just direct the band. Because that's all
